# Wang Jianguo's plan for this year

*[reasoning in first person]*

I've been on this 13.1 mu for 30 years, so I mostly do what works. My wife helps but she's got bad knees now, so for the heavy work I hire machines — combine for both harvests, no-till planter for maize. Our boy's in the city, doesn't come back for farming anymore. Two mouths to feed, not much pressure on food, so I sell most of the grain.

**Wheat first.** I'll plant around October 8-10, right after I clear the maize stalks. I buy Jimai 22 seed from the dealer in town — that's what most people use here. About 15 yuan/mu for seed, 15 kg seeding rate. For fertilizer, the extension station always says 15 kg N/mu but I put on a bit more to be safe — you lose more from too little than from too much. I do a base of 50 kg/mu compound (15-15-15) before planting, then topdress urea about 20 kg/mu at green-up in early March. That comes to maybe 17 kg N/mu total. Irrigation — winter water if December is dry, then green-up water March, jointing water April, and one at grain-fill if May stays dry. Well water costs me about 15 yuan/mu each time with electricity, so I try to hold it to 3 rounds. Weeds I spray once in spring with the usual herbicide. If I see aphids at grain-fill I'll spot-spray. Expect about 475 kg/mu — last year was 490, year before was 450 because of the late frost.

**Maize right after.** Wheat harvest mid-June, then 3-4 days to get maize in the ground. I hire Old Zhang's no-till planter, 30 yuan/mu. Seed is Zhengdan 958, about 40 yuan/mu — everyone plants it around here, yields are reliable. I put a little compound at planting, maybe 20 kg/mu, then big topdress at knee-high stage end of July, urea 25 kg/mu. That's around 15 kg N/mu total. Summer rain usually covers maize but if July turns dry I'll irrigate once at tasseling. Herbicide after planting. Expect 500 kg/mu, maybe better if the rains come right.

Cash is always the worry — fertilizer prices keep going up. I'd rather have less cash left over and more fertilizer on the field than cut back and lose yield.
